title: Melusines are... Melusines?
description:
Melusines are a special species of Teyvat that have inhabited Fontaine since 400 years ago. They have cute appearances such as being short in stature, mitten-like hands, long tufted tails; long ear- or horn-like head protrusions, stubby feet. They may also have small wing-like appendages on their backs as well!

All melusines are considered female, have excellent eyesight and increased perception relative to normal humans, seeing the world differently from them. Due to these traits including their overall friendly personality, they have fitted themselves well into human society, working with the people of fontaine.

Lastly, all melusines have a common father. They were born from the wounds of the great beast Elynas, which continued to take care of the melusines even in their death through their consciousness.

 Melusines are truly cute creatures, aren't they? Where did they actually come from?

In the real world, a Melusine is a figure from European folklore who is a female spirit of fresh water in a holy spring or river. She is typically shown as a woman who is a snake or fish from the waist down (similar to a lamia or mermaid). She is occasionally seen with wings, two tails, or both. Her stories are particularly associated with the northern and western regions of France, and the Low Countries. (Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg)

I think I could say that I prefer the melusines that the game has right now...

"Melusines are beautiful creatures. They are the pride of Fontaine. Be sure to befriend them, and cause them no harm." - Neuvillette, Chat: Melusines.

What about you, do you have any favorite Melusine out there? Let us know!
